page.overview:
Who is Euan Abercrombie?

Euan Abercrombie was a wizard and Gryffindor student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the 1990s.

He began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in September 1995, when Harry was in his fifth year. As he was first in his year alphabetically, he was the first to be sorted, and was sorted into Gryffindor House. He was a small boy with prominent ears, who often looked terrified. He appeared to believe in the Daily Prophet's smear campaign against Harry Potter, as he looked at him fearfully when Harry tried to smile at him.
